frequency_question: How frequently do congressional joint resolutions to block nuclear cooperation or arms sales agreements successfully pass both chambers and overcome presidential vetoes?
membership_rule: Includes formal 123 agreements and major arms sales submitted for congressional review; excludes non-binding resolutions of disapproval or those failing to clear committee.
